title: The Dark Sector
description: Most of the universe's mass does not interact with light. Unlocks the Dark Matter Halo Collector.

puzzle.goal: Stars far out in a galaxy orbit at speeds that stay roughly constant with radius, so most of the mass must be invisible. Model the halo with a density that falls as 1/s near the centre and 1/s³ far out, with scale radius a. Write the squared orbital speed at radius r from the mass enclosed in spherical shells out to r.
puzzle.name: Circular velocity of a Navarro–Frenk–White dark-matter halo
puzzle.ask: The integral gives an enclosed mass 4πρ0a³[ln(1 + r/a) − r/(a + r)]. Find the orbital speed in km/s at the radius below.
puzzle.method: Balance gravity against centripetal acceleration, v²/r = GM(r)/r², and build M(r) by integrating density over thin spherical shells of area 4πs².
